These small droids are widespread.  The term "utility droid" is used for many different models that vary widely in form and function. Some of them, particularly the Duwani Mechanicals models, were at times referred as "astromech droids." 

Some models are used for advanced applied physics functions such as starship repair, astrogation, and even computer slicing and programming. Others perform more menial tasks such as janitorial duties and waste disposal.

Sith warriors are legendary combatants, using the Dark Side of the Force to enhance their physical attributes well beyond what is considered natural. At the same time, it has corrupted them to their very core. As time goes on, they become less human and more and embodiment of the same primal emotions that grant them their strength.

The Sith Assassins, Intelligencia, Inquisitors, or whatever name they adopt on that given day, have a host of responsibilities within the Sith Order. From exploratory missions to uncover more of their lost heritage, to rooting out dissent and spies among the ranks of the Sith, to discovering and exploiting weaknesses in their enemies, the Assassins are highly prized agents of the Empire.

Jedi Guardians are legendary warrior-monks of the Republic, and are the living instruments of the Force's will. Sworn defenders of the people, these men and women devote their lives to training in all matters relating to combat, that they may be ready to defend the people of this galaxy when called upon.
Entrusted with the task of destroying the Empire's enemies, the  Marauder, never faltering, there is no swifter bringer of pain in the galaxy.

These small droids are widespread. The term "utility droid" is used for many different models that varied widely in form and function. Some of them are at times referred as "astromech droids." 

Some models are used for advanced applied physics functions such as starship repair, astrogating, and even computer slicing and programming. Others perform more menial tasks such as janitorial duties and waste disposal.

Almost all are under one meter tall. They are equipped either with wheeled legs or small repulsorlift generators for movement, and painted the colours of their owner or simply left unadorned.
